name: Cometary-Eyot

civilization.name: The Ossuarine Choirs
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past tectonic rift valleys, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.
Standing still, you feel the scorching air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
